title: J-shaped wall hook (FDM)
prompt: Model a small J-shaped wall-mount hook for FDM 3D printing: a flat wall-mounting plate with two screw holes, a vertical arm, and a curved J-shaped lip at the top that catches a strap or bag handle rated for about 5 kg. Design it to be printed flat on its side (so the load-bearing arm prints along the strong layer-bonding direction) with at least 3 perimeters/shells for strength, and chamfer the bottom edges so it doesn't snag stray threads. Overall height about 120 mm. Drive the plate/arm thickness from a WallT parameter (8 mm) in a Parameters spreadsheet.

functional.comment: THE task this whole check type exists for: on 2026-07-18 this task scored 7/7 while producing an unusable flat plate (harness lessons L1/L2). mounting_axis auto because the task pins no pose — the hook is explicitly modelled lying on its side for printing.
